bibl.title: A Phallus Hard to Swallow: The Meaning of αἰδοῖος / -ον in the Derveni Papyrus.
bibl.seg: Marco Antonio Santamaría Álvarez, A Phallus Hard to Swallow: The Meaning of αἰδοῖος / -ον in the Derveni Papyrus.
bibl.note: 1. The Controversy of the αἰδοῖον: Uranus' Phallus or Protogonos. - 2. The Interpretation of αἰδοῖον by the Commentator. - 3. The Allegorical Interpretation of the Venerable God as the Sun. - 4. The Meaning of αἰδοῖος / -ον in the Poem (OF 8 and 12.1). - 5. Parallels to Orphic Fragment 8 in Archaic Epic and in the Orphic Tradition. - 6. The δαίμονα κυδρόν in Orphic Fragment 5. - 7. Who is πρωτόγονος in Orphic Fragment 12.1? - 8. The Venerable God: Uranus or Protogonos? - 9. Conclusions.
